subproblem.title: Uniform bound and Lipschitz bound for D^2 Psi on a closed ball of L(R^n, R^l)
subproblem.statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) (continuous linear maps Rn n ->L Rn l with the operator norm), Psi : L -> R of class C^3 and eps a real number. Write B(P)[Q][Q'] := D^2 Psi(P)[Q][Q'] = fderiv R (fderiv R Psi) P Q Q'. Then there are real numbers M_B >= 0 and L_B >= 0 such that (i) |B(P)[Q][Q']| <= M_B ||Q|| ||Q'|| for all P, Q, Q' in L with ||P|| <= eps, and (ii) |B(P)[Q][Q'] - B(P')[Q][Q']| <= L_B ||P - P'|| ||Q|| ||Q'|| for all P, P', Q, Q' in L with ||P|| <= eps and ||P'|| <= eps.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 3 Ψ → ∀ ε : ℝ, ∃ MB LB : ℝ, 0 ≤ MB ∧ 0 ≤ LB ∧ (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q'| ≤ MB * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖) ∧ ∀ P P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ‖P'‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q' - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P' Q Q'| ≤ LB * ‖P - P'‖ * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Step 1 of the parent proof (the constants M_B, L_B of Psi on the closed eps-ball), written out in full.
Notation. L is a finite-dimensional real normed space, so its closed balls are compact. Let L* := L(L, R) and Bil := L(L, L*) be the spaces of continuous linear forms and of continuous bilinear forms on L with their operator norms; for beta in Bil and Q, Q' in L, |beta[Q][Q']| <= ||beta[Q]|| ||Q'|| <= ||beta|| ||Q|| ||Q'|| (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm2). Put A := D Psi : L -> L* and B := D A : L -> Bil, so that B(P)[Q][Q'] = fderiv R (fderiv R Psi) P Q Q'.
1. Regularity. Psi is C^3, hence A = fderiv R Psi is C^2 and B = fderiv R A is C^1 (ContDiff.fderiv_right, twice). So B is continuous, B is differentiable at every point, and its derivative DB = fderiv R B : L -> L(L, Bil) is continuous (ContDiff.continuous_fderiv).
2. The set Kc := closedBall(0, eps) in L is compact (finite dimension; for eps < 0 it is empty, which is also compact) and convex.
3. Bound (i). B is continuous on the compact set Kc, so there is M with ||B(P)|| <= M for all P in Kc (IsCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn). Put M_B := max(M, 0) >= 0. For P with ||P|| <= eps (that is, P in Kc) and any Q, Q' in L: |B(P)[Q][Q']| <= ||B(P)|| ||Q|| ||Q'|| <= M_B ||Q|| ||Q'||, using ||Q|| ||Q'|| >= 0.
4. Lipschitz estimate for B. DB is continuous on Kc, so there is L0 with ||DB(P)|| <= L0 for P in Kc; put L_B := max(L0, 0) >= 0. Kc is convex, B is differentiable at every point of Kc and ||DB|| <= L_B on Kc, so the mean value inequality on convex sets (Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le) gives ||B(P) - B(P')|| <= L_B ||P - P'|| for all P, P' in Kc.
5. Bound (ii). For P, P' in Kc and Q, Q' in L, B(P)[Q][Q'] - B(P')[Q][Q'] = (B(P) - B(P'))[Q][Q'], so by the Notation paragraph and step 4, |B(P)[Q][Q'] - B(P')[Q][Q']| <= ||B(P) - B(P')|| ||Q|| ||Q'|| <= L_B ||P - P'|| ||Q|| ||Q'||. Steps 3 and 5 prove the claim with M_B, L_B >= 0. QED
Instance note: the norm on Bil and on L(L, Bil) for L = Rn n ->L Rn l needs set_option maxSynthPendingDepth; depth 3 is not enough for the type of D^3 Psi(P) (L ->L L ->L L ->L R), depth 5 is (checked).

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 5 in
theorem Submission.dohr_eb_elc2_hessian_bounds : ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 3 Ψ → ∀ ε : ℝ, ∃ MB LB : ℝ, 0 ≤ MB ∧ 0 ≤ LB ∧ (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q'| ≤ MB * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖) ∧ ∀ P P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ‖P'‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q' - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P' Q Q'| ≤ LB * ‖P - P'‖ * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖ := by
  intro n ℓ Ψ hΨ ε
  have h2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ Ψ) := hΨ.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have h1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ)) := h2.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hBc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ)) := h1.continuous
  have hDBc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ))) := h1.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
  have hK : IsCompact (closedBall (0 : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) ε) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hBc.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hDBc.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max M 0, max L 0, le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro P hP Q Q'
    have hPm : P ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) ε := by simpa using hP
    have h := (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P).le_opNorm₂ Q Q'
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    gcongr
    exact (hM P hPm).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · intro P P' hP hP' Q Q'
    have hPm : P ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) ε := by simpa using hP
    have hP'm : P' ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) ε := by simpa using hP'
    have hmv : ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P'‖ ≤ max L 0 * ‖P - P'‖ :=
      (convex_closedBall _ _).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
        (fun x _ => (h1.differentiable (by norm_num)) x)
        (fun x hx => (hL x hx).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hP'm hPm
    have h := (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P').le_opNorm₂ Q Q'
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    gcongr

proof_key_steps: Psi C^3 => B = D^2 Psi is C^1 with continuous derivative DB
closedBall(0, eps) in L is compact and convex
M_B := bound of ||B|| on the ball; |B(P)[Q][Q']| <= ||B(P)|| ||Q|| ||Q'||
L_B := bound of ||DB|| on the ball; mean value inequality gives ||B(P) - B(P')|| <= L_B ||P - P'||
apply the operator-norm inequality to B(P) - B(P')
